stanza:label: Gene / CREs
stanza:definition: Compare the CREs of a gene and its ortholog in the other species: their positions, the orthologous TFs they share, the mouse strains carrying the same variants and the human variants those strains model. Entered from a human or a mouse gene. (data integration of fanta.bio, ChIP-Atlas, NCBI Orthologs, TogoCoord, TogoID/HomoloGene, MoG+ and TogoVar)
stanza:author: moriya_dbcls

stanza:parameter.stanza:description: HGNC ID of the human gene. Give one of hgnc_id, mgi_id or ncbigene_id. (e.g. 404)
MGI ID of the mouse gene; carried to its human ortholog through TogoID (e.g. MGI:99600)
NCBI Gene ID of a human or mouse gene; the species is decided by whether it has an HGNC ID (e.g. 11669)
Base URL of the SPARQList that serves gene_cre and gene_cre_mogp
TogoVar base URL; togovar_cre_mogplus returns site-relative variant links, which are resolved against it. Set it to an empty string to keep them relative.
MoG+ version queried for the variant table (mogplus21, mogplus3)
Which way the two genome tracks run. genome: both along the plus strand. gene: each follows its own gene 5' to 3', so a gene pair on opposite strands stops its liftOver ribbons crossing.

stanza:style.stanza:description: accent color of the human track
accent color of the mouse track
